metadata.title: Unconditional console.log() in FieldComponent Constructor — Continuous Terminal PII Disclosure

sources: ApplinX REST API GetScreenResponse fields[].content and fields[].visualContent (terminal screen data)
transformations: FieldComponent instantiated for each field (@Input() field binding)
Constructor executes: this.field ? console.log('>>@constructor>>> this.field.content = ', this.field.content) : ''
sinks: Browser console (F12 DevTools) — accessible to users and XSS code
Browser console history buffer — persists for session duration

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Read access to all terminal screen field data logged during the session

impact.description: All terminal screen content (field.content and field.visualContent) continuously logged to browser console at 1,200-4,800 entries/minute. Terminal data includes: account numbers, PINs, usernames, transaction codes. Angular production build does NOT remove console.log() by default — no environment guard present. Upgraded from LOW to MEDIUM.

prerequisites: Proven: any user can open browser DevTools (F12) and observe continuous logging without technical barrier
XSS amplification: prior XSS exploitation (VULN-004) to automate collection

remediation.fix_approach: Remove the two console.log() calls from FieldComponent constructor (lines 35-36). Remove or gate MacroComponent console.log() calls (lines 231, 235, 239, 272) behind if (!environment.production). Add terser drop_console in angular.json production build as belt-and-suspenders.

history.note: Active console.log() in FieldComponent constructor logs all terminal screen data on every field render; GXUtils global mutable statics

Confirmed unconditional console.log() in production. Angular production build does NOT strip console.log() — no environment guard. 1,200-4,800 entries/min of terminal PII. Upgraded from LOW to MEDIUM (proven exploitability — any user, no technical barrier). Part of AC-004.
